title: Dyson swarm — the solved star-capture
description: Level 2's signature: a swarm of collectors capturing the star's full output (speculative).
body: SPECULATIVE — the Dyson swarm: millions of solar collectors orbiting the star, capturing its full ~10^26 W output, is the signature solved technology of a level-2 civilization. Freeman Dyson proposed the concept in 1960 as a SETI search target; no evidence of one exists. Speculative, labeled as such.
